# Draft:Dark Queen of Samobor (video game)

----
Dark Queen of Samobor is a narrative 2.5D action-adventure game set in a haunting reinterpretation of Slavic and Croatian mythology. Developed by Downtown Game Studio in Croatia, the game invites players to step inside a cursed fairytale book and take on the role of a knight drawn into a dark, emotional journey through a forgotten world.
As players progress, they will explore richly atmospheric and symbolic environments ranging from rotting swamps and surreal dreamlike forests to icy caverns and oppressive mountain peaks. Each biome reflects a distinct emotional state and is inhabited by myth-inspired enemies and deadly creatures rooted in Slavic folklore.
Gameplay combines hack and slash combat, puzzle-solving, and cinemati
c storytelling with a fully manually directed camera, inspired by games like Inside and Planet of Lana. Audio plays a vital role, with high-quality sound powered by FMOD and immersive voice acting. The antagonist, the mysterious Dark Queen, is voiced by acclaimed Croatian actress Sandra Lončarić, whose chilling narration guides the trailer and key moments in the game.
Dark Queen of Samobor is currently in development and planned for release in late 2026.
